# RestaBee

> RestaBee is restaurant POS software for restaurants in India. It brings dine-in, takeaway and staff-entered delivery orders into one workflow for order entry, kitchen preparation, table service, billing and reporting.

Use this guide to find the public product, feature, pricing and support pages. Product screenshots show the RestaBee software; any sample restaurant records shown in them are illustrative.

## Product overview

- [Restaurant POS software](https://restabee.com/): How RestaBee connects restaurant orders, floor service, kitchen tickets and bills, with a product overview and demo request.
- [Restaurant management software](https://restabee.com/restaurant-management-software/): The broader restaurant workspace for front-of-house, kitchen, cashier and owner operations.
- [Features directory](https://restabee.com/features/): Browse the restaurant POS capabilities and open a dedicated page for each workflow.
- [Restaurant POS capabilities](https://restabee.com/#capabilities): A concise view of the core workflows supported by the product.
- [Pricing](https://restabee.com/pricing/): Public subscription terms for single-outlet and multi-outlet restaurants.
- [Request a demo](https://restabee.com/#demo): Send RestaBee a restaurant enquiry.

## POS workflows and features

- [Restaurant order management system](https://restabee.com/features/restaurant-order-management/): Dine-in, takeaway and staff-entered delivery orders, item choices, kitchen handoff and bill progression.
- [Restaurant table management](https://restabee.com/features/restaurant-table-management/): Live floor sections, table states, waiting parties, seating, service assignments and bill requests.
- [Table QR ordering](https://restabee.com/#qr-ordering): Guests browse a table menu and submit an order for staff review before preparation.
- [Kitchen order ticket system](https://restabee.com/features/kot-management/): Preparation tickets, station routing, order instructions, amendments and ticket progress.
- [Kitchen display system](https://restabee.com/features/kitchen-display-system/): Digital kitchen queues for new, preparing and ready items, including station and partial-quantity progress.
- [Restaurant billing software](https://restabee.com/features/restaurant-billing-software/): Bill preparation and issue, configured tax, discounts, payment records and outstanding balances.
- [Restaurant menu management software](https://restabee.com/features/restaurant-menu-management/): Shared menu catalog, review and publication, with outlet-specific menu management.
- [Multi-outlet restaurant management](https://restabee.com/features/multi-outlet-restaurant-management/): Central menu releases, outlet access and outlet-scoped reporting for restaurant groups.
- [Restaurant cash management](https://restabee.com/features/restaurant-cash-management/): Opening floats, cash movements, shift counts and closing variance review.
- [Restaurant sales reports](https://restabee.com/features/restaurant-sales-reports/): Issued sales, collections, item and category sales, discounts, taxes and shift activity.
- [Cafe POS](https://restabee.com/solutions/cafe-pos/): Cafe counter and dine-in orders, menu choices, preparation, billing and sales reports.

## Company and policies

- [Contact RestaBee](https://restabee.com/contact/): Contact details and the demo enquiry form.
- [Privacy policy](https://restabee.com/privacy-policy/): Privacy practices for the RestaBee platform, restaurant accounts and demo enquiries.

## Product boundaries

- Delivery orders are entered by restaurant staff; the website does not describe a delivery marketplace or dispatch network.
- Table QR orders are reviewed by staff before they are sent for preparation.
- Pricing and included features are described on the public pricing page. Internal sales pricing documents are not public product terms.
